narration-on: Narration, on. Films play with their descriptions.
narration-off: Narration, off. Films play with their own sound only.
level-quiet: Voice level, quiet. The film barely dips under the voice.
level-normal: Voice level, normal. The film dips under each description.
level-loud: Voice level, loud. The film drops well back, so every word is clear.
density-sparse: How much is said, only what changed most. Half as much talking.
picture-panel: Picture, with the voice panel. The film sits beside what is being said.
picture-full: Picture, full screen. The descriptions show as captions over the film.
